dimensions.name: Queue handling
dimensions.signal: Sorts a queue of tickets by impact and states the order.
questions: Tell me about a piece of work you planned.

1.anchor: Worked the queue in arrival order.

2.anchor: Sorted by impact with help, and kept first replies < 4 hours on the sample queue.

3.anchor: Sorted by impact alone and stated why each of the first three tickets came first.
